name: nextjs-combo
description: Full-stack NestJS + Next.js development workflow. Combines the w-task state machine (intake → context → plan → impact → UI/Figma → TDD → browser-verify → docs → PR) with the official Figma design-to-code suite: figma-context-extractor absorbs the MCP payloads into an exact figma-spec.md, figma-asset-fetcher downloads real icons and images instead of generating them, figma-design-system-mapper resolves Figma values against the project's own tokens and components, and a Phase 3.4 visual parity gate blocks the task until computed styles match the design. Includes Chrome DevTools MCP for localhost verification, the cloud-infrastructure security review checklist, and the terraform MCP server for IaC. Supersedes the deprecated `nestjs-nextjs` preset.

external_setup.name: mgrep
external_setup.notes: Semantic code search plugin. settings_patch registers the Mixedbread-Grep marketplace and auto-enables the plugin.

external_setup.name: figma
external_setup.install_hint: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp — then run /mcp and authorise in the browser. For the local server instead, enable the MCP server in Figma desktop (Preferences) and point the url at http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp.
external_setup.notes: This is NOT the legacy @figma/mcp REST server. The official server provides get_design_context, get_metadata, get_variable_defs, get_screenshot, get_code_connect_map and a localhost asset endpoint — the rendered reference and real asset exports the legacy REST server never had. A project that keeps the old f-* suite installed must not register both under the name `figma`.

external_setup.name: chrome-devtools
external_setup.install_hint: Auto-installs via npx. Requires Node.js and Google Chrome 144+.
external_setup.notes: Drives figma-verify-parity. Without it the parity gate reports NOT RUN, which is deliberately distinct from PASS — a skipped check must stay visible.

external_setup.name: terraform
external_setup.install_hint: Requires Docker. Pulls hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server:0.4.0. Set TFE_TOKEN env var for Terraform Cloud/Enterprise access.
external_setup.notes: Infrastructure-as-Code automation for AWS/cloud provisioning. Optional — only needed when working on Terraform/IaC. Pairs with the security-review skill's cloud-infrastructure-security checklist.
